Kuala Lumpur

Kuala Lumpur 3

  1. Must see · Kuala Lumpur

    Petronas Twin Towers

    The 452 m twin towers with the double-decker skybridge — KL's defining landmark, once the world's tallest buildings.

    Look for Skyscraper & skybridge

    Kuala Lumpur City Centre (KLCC), Jalan Ampang, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

    Recommended by Cuisine Wat Damnak (official), Wikipedia

  2. Must see · Kuala Lumpur

    Batu Caves

    A limestone hill of Hindu cave temples reached by 272 rainbow steps under the giant golden Murugan statue; focus of the Thaipusam festival.

    Look for Hindu cave temple

    Gombak, Selangor (Greater Kuala Lumpur), Malaysia

    Recommended by Tourism Malaysia, Wikipedia

  3. Must see · Malay & Nasi Padang · Kuala Lumpur

    Village Park Restaurant

    The nasi lemak many call Malaysia's best; queues since the 1980s for the ayam goreng berempah. Regulars have included prime ministers and national athletes.

    5 Jalan SS21/37, Damansara Utama (Uptown), Petaling Jaya, Selangor (Greater KL), Malaysia

    Recommended by Seth Lui, SilverKris (Singapore Airlines)

How this guide was made

Web-searched & fact-checked
